tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Page ground under the backdrop image. Never carries text directly; text sits on `surface`.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Panels, cards, app bar. The ground for `ink` body text.

tokens.name: surface-sunk
tokens.usage: Inputs, wells and the idle stage nodes. Carries `ink` text.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Control borders and stitch lines on `surface` and `surface-sunk` (3:1 or better).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: The only text color on `canvas`, `surface`, `surface-sunk` and every `tint-*`. There is no muted text.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: The 3px keyboard focus ring. At least 3:1 on every surface.

tokens.name: rose
tokens.usage: Rose thread. Warm accent for personal projects and the primary in Colorful. Solid fills: buttons, tile art, swatches, completed stitches. 3:1 or better on `surface`.

tokens.name: on-rose
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `rose`.

tokens.name: tint-rose
tokens.usage: Soft rose ground for tiles and card art. Carries `ink` text.

tokens.name: madder
tokens.usage: Madder red. Carries the danger state and warm project accents. Solid fills: buttons, tile art, swatches, completed stitches. 3:1 or better on `surface`.

tokens.name: on-madder
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `madder`.

tokens.name: tint-madder
tokens.usage: Soft madder ground for tiles and card art. Carries `ink` text.

tokens.name: marigold
tokens.usage: Marigold. Sunny accent; the primary in Dark. Solid fills: buttons, tile art, swatches, completed stitches. 3:1 or better on `surface`.

tokens.name: on-marigold
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `marigold`.

tokens.name: tint-marigold
tokens.usage: Soft marigold ground for tiles and card art. Carries `ink` text.

tokens.name: fern
tokens.usage: Fern green. Fabric and natural-fibre accents. Solid fills: buttons, tile art, swatches, completed stitches. 3:1 or better on `surface`.

tokens.name: on-fern
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `fern`.

tokens.name: tint-fern
tokens.usage: Soft fern ground for tiles and card art. Carries `ink` text.

tokens.name: teal
tokens.usage: Teal. The primary in Light and the success state in every theme. Solid fills: buttons, tile art, swatches, completed stitches. 3:1 or better on `surface`.

tokens.name: on-teal
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `teal`.

tokens.name: tint-teal
tokens.usage: Soft teal ground for tiles and card art. Carries `ink` text.

tokens.name: cornflower
tokens.usage: Cornflower blue. Measurement and planning accents. Solid fills: buttons, tile art, swatches, completed stitches. 3:1 or better on `surface`.

tokens.name: on-cornflower
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `cornflower`.

tokens.name: tint-cornflower
tokens.usage: Soft cornflower ground for tiles and card art. Carries `ink` text.

tokens.name: plum
tokens.usage: Plum. Deep accent for tailoring and formal work. Solid fills: buttons, tile art, swatches, completed stitches. 3:1 or better on `surface`.

tokens.name: on-plum
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `plum`.

tokens.name: tint-plum
tokens.usage: Soft plum ground for tiles and card art. Carries `ink` text.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: The main action color: Teal in Light, Rose in Colorful, Marigold in Dark.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `primary`.

tokens.name: tint-primary
tokens.usage: Tonal buttons and selected grounds. Carries `ink` text.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Error borders and the error icon. Always paired with the `alert` icon and a message, never color alone.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Completed stages. Teal sits off the red-green axis from `danger`, and done stages also carry the check shape.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: One per page: the project or screen name. Drops to 40px under 600px wide.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Panel titles. Drops to 30px under 600px wide.

styles.name: subheading
styles.usage: Tile labels and the app bar name.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Cut the lining on the fold.
styles.usage: All running text. The floor for reading text.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Buttons, field labels, units and messages. The smallest size in the system.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Icon to label gap.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between a field label and its control.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Page gutter on phones; gaps inside controls.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding on phones; grid gap on phones.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Card and panel padding; grid gap from tablet up; page gutter on tablets.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Page gutter on desktop; space between page sections.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Hero panel padding on desktop.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs and small art.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Tile art, card art.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Panels, cards, tiles.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, swatches, theme discs.

tokens.name: shadow-raise
tokens.usage: Panels, cards and tiles lifted off the backdrop.

tokens.name: target
tokens.usage: Minimum height and width of anything you can press.

tokens.name: icon
tokens.usage: Icons inside buttons and fields.

tokens.name: icon-lg
tokens.usage: Icons in tile art and stage nodes.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Widest the page content grows.
